entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Getting container metadata from another project #49903
    Backlog
  • Re-enable compose store tests #49900
  • Assembly.GetType return always excetion, args "throwOnError" don`t work. .NET 9.0 #49894
  • Template names in dotnet new list output are being truncated with ellipsis #49893
  • .NET 10 Shebang Issue: `#!/usr/bin/dotnet` intercepts script arguments as dotnet commands #49892

Closed

  • Hang in <Exec "dotnet build" #25543
  • Building legacy iOS projects fails with latest Mono and .NET 6.0.300 SDK #25651
  • [ARM64] With SDK 3.1.420 and 6.0.301 installed, failed to load the dll from [C:\Program Files\dotnet\host\fxr\6.0.6\hostfxr.dll], HRESULT: 0x800700C1 when dotnet run 3.1 project #25649
  • Resource sattelite assemblies are not generated when using dotnet cli #25632
  • Unable to exclude JSON files from being copied to the output directory with `blazorwasm` template #25587
  • What kind of SSL/TLS certificate is being used for dotnet sdk check? #25568
  • dotnet app.cs #:sdk directive pinned version results in The SDK 'Sdk/Version' specified could not be found. #49797
    10.0.1xx
  • some problem with dotnet publish #10340
    Discussion
  • dotnet msbuild -t:restore or -t:publish : NU1201: Not compatible with netcoreapp2.2 #3266
    Discussion
  • `dotnet project convert` works incorrectly for target framework other than default base framework `net10.0` #49177
    10.0.1xx
  • Update pruned package data for packages that ship out of dotnet/maintenance-packages #47314
    10.0.1xx
  • Add an MSBuild property to indicate that a project is a file-based app #49846

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview7] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49905
  • Switch back to using the unofficial templates for PRs #49904
    Branch Lockdown
  • Use project directory as a working directory for Aspire processes #49901
    Area-AspNetCore
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview7] Override default properties with custom file-level directives #49898
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview7] Ensure all evaluation data are in binlogs from file-based apps #49896

Merged

  • Remove unneccessary crypto using #49864
    Area-Containers
  • Update implicit version with the June version for main #49883
    Area-CodeFlow
  • Update copilot-setup-steps.yml #49848
    Area-CodeFlow
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview7] Handle versioned `#:sdk` being first #49899
  • Fix code owners for NuGet code #49902
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview7] Fix tool projects so they don't remove apphosts when publishing (not packing) #49897
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Tools
  • Handle versioned `#:sdk` being first #49807
    Area-run-file
  • Override default properties with custom file-level directives #49767
    Area-run-file
  • Update maintenance-packages pruning versions #49092
  • Minimal work to make System.Diagnostics.Activity usable by the dotnet CLI application and codebase #49749
    Area-CLI
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview7] Cherry-pick @nagilson's containers test skips because of backport issues #49895
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Containers
  • Add property FileBasedProgram #49861
    Area-run-file

Updated

  • Add support for flat launch settings #49769
    Area-run-file
  • Implementing dotnet pack with nuspec files #49813
  • Update the minimum msbuild version for .NET 10 #49531
  • Add support for CsWinRT 3.0 multi-targeting via Windows SDK build number #49721
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix --no-build flag error message inconsistency for non-existent project files #49544
  • Send Ctrl+C to launched process before killing it on Windows #49847
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Add a series of changes to make devcontainer experiences nicer for this repo #49867
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49740
    Area-CodeFlow, Area-VMR
  • Implement `#:package` manipulation for file-based apps #49635
    Area-run-file
  • [release/9.0.1xx] Add .NET 6.0 to End-of-Life frameworks list to generate NETSDK1138 warnings #49822
    Servicing-approved, Branch Lockdown, 9.0.9
  • Add .NET 6.0 to EOL frameworks list #49823
    Servicing-approved, Branch Lockdown, 8.0.19
